notes: Year digits are text-verified on the page; the month letter (5th character) is chart-only, so this file ships year-only per the year-only precedent. Month unblocked by the page's chart image (see report image-pass list). Page example serial used as the example.

styles.notes: Page positions 3-4 (1-based) = year, converted to 0-based half-open [2,4]. Page positions 5 (1-based) = month letter, chart-only, not encoded. Page example 0106K4606307.
